The <b>Cloakless Crest</b> is a temporary [[Crests|Crest]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i> used if Hornet is captured and taken to [[the Slab]]. Hornet loses the [[Needle]], [[Hunter's Cloak]] (and its upgrades), and most other items in her Inventory. The Crest menu cannot be accessed at all until Hornet retrieves her items. She retains [[Swift Step]] and [[Cling Grip]].

== Attacks ==
Hornet attacks at the same speed as the [[Hunter Crest]]. Her attacks deal 3 damage regardless of [[Needle]] upgrades and enemy [[Damage_Values_and_Enemy_Health_(Silksong)#Damage_Calculation|Damage Modifiers]].
* Neutral Slashes: Hornet alternates between kicks and roundhouse kicks in the facing direction. The range and shape of the attacks are similar to the [[Wanderer Crest]].
* Down-slash: Hornet performs a dive kick with a similar trajectory to the [[Hunter Crest]]'s. This cannot be used to bounce off spikes.
* [[Swift Step|Run-slash]]: Hornet performs a jumping kick, bouncing into the air if she hits an enemy.
* [[Needle Strike]]: Cannot be used.

== Mechanics ==
All Inventory [[Items (Silksong)|Items]] except the following are removed:
* [[Bind]]
* [[Silk Heart]]s
* [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shards]]
* [[Spool Fragment]]s
* [[Swift Step]]
* [[Cling Grip]]
This means the following can <b>not</b> be used:
* [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Map and Quill]]
** A map of the Slab can be found and used, but not updated.
* [[Drifter's Cloak]]
* [[Needolin]]
* [[Needle Strike]]
* [[Clawline]]
* [[Faydown Cloak]]

[[Skills]] and [[Tools]] cannot be used or equipped, and Crests cannot be swapped, as the Menu for doing so disappears entirely.

To remove the Crest and regain her belongings, Hornet must navigate the Slab until she finds a Wardenfly wearing her Cloak and wielding her Needle. A prompt will appear to perform a takedown through the trapdoor Hornet is standing on. 
{{Gallery
|Image1=Mapshot SS Key of Heretic.png!Location of Wardenfly holding Hornet's belongings
|Image2=Screenshot SS Cloakless Crest 03.png!The prompt to Attack the Wardenfly and reclaim Hornet's belongings}}

Hornet drops through the trapdoor, breaks the Wardenfly's neck, and reclaims her belongings, switching to the last used Crest and {{CrestSlot|Skill|1}} but with no tools. She must then fight through waves of enemies. If Hornet is killed in the gauntlet outside of [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], she respawns at the last [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] with the Cloakless Crest back and her inventory missing again. On defeating the waves of enemies, the [[Key of Heretic]] can be acquired and used to leave the Slab.

== Usefulness ==
The Cloakless Crest is entirely detrimental, reducing Hornet's damage and range. It cannot be used outside [[the Slab]].

Hornet can avoid getting captured and sent to the Slab. However, if she is captured, the following can be obtained as early as [[Act 1]], without acquiring the [[Slab Keys|Key of Apostate]]:

== How to Acquire ==
After defeating the [[Bell Beast]] and acquiring [[Cling Grip]], [[Wardenfly|Wardenflies]] wielding Hornet-sized cages can appear in [[Deep Docks]] and [[Bilewater]], in areas that are now reachable by wall jumping. Upon completing the <i>[[SEARCH: Silent Halls]]</i> [[Acts|objective]] at the start of [[Act 2]], a third cage-wielding Wardenfly appears in [[Greymoor]]. If one of these Wardenflies successfully slams the cage onto her, Hornet will be transported to the Slab with this Crest automatically equipped. 

* While Hornet is [[Cursed Crest|Cursed]], she cannot be captured; when caged, roots will thrash out from her to destroy the cage and kill the Wardenfly.

* When cage-wielding Wardenflies are killed, they do not respawn or get replaced; if all three die, the Cloakless Crest can no longer be obtained on this playthrough.

* If Hornet has already been captured and has escaped, enters the top of the Slab using the [[Slab Keys|Key of Apostate]], or enters [[Act 3]], the remaining cage-wielding Wardenflies disappear. This makes the Cloakless Crest impossible to [re]acquire.

== Trivia ==
* The Cloakless Crest is the only Crest that alters Hornet's appearance.
* Getting arrested and recovering Hornet's equipment is the only way to hear the track [[Soundtrack (Silksong)#Track Listing|Red Maiden]] (which uses the same melody as [[Hornet Protector|Hornet]]'s boss theme in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>) in-game.{{BandcampPlayer|Red Maiden}}
* When in the areas of the slab that have the [[Mount Fay]] frosting effect, Hornet frosts twice as fast compared to with her cloak.<ref group=Source name="frosting">From the code, TickFrostEffect() and GetTotalFrostSpeed() functions in HeroCotroller class</ref>
* While Cloakless, if Hornet sits on a bench and checks her map, she will be twitching one of her legs. {{MissingImage}}
